disposition_reason: Table 5 prints per-sample Ca, Cd, Cr, Cu, Fe, K, Mg, Mn and Pb for five commercial traditional Turkish red sugar samples by two sample-preparation methods.

unresolved: Lead differs markedly between MAE and UA-DES-E for samples S1, S3, S4 and S5 (for example 426.1 vs 918.6 µg/kg); the paper does not say which is closer to the true total.
Red sugar is not a syrup; it is a proxy only for pancake-syrup.
